chunks: When misfortune befalls men they pray to their Lord and turn to Him; but afterwards when He has given them a taste of His benevolence a section of them begins to ascribe compeers to their Lord
ai.seo_question: How do humans typically respond to hardship versus ease according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ar-Rum is often cited to illustrate the human tendency toward spiritual amnesia, where distress triggers immediate reliance on God (tawhid), but ease leads to complacency and shirk. It underscores the psychological reality that hardship serves as a catalyst for repentance, while prosperity can become a test of gratitude and monotheism.
